$ python -c "
from libzim.reader import Archive
from libzim.search import Searcher, Query
import re

zim_path = r'D:\迅雷下载\wikipedia_en_all_nopic_2026-03.zim'
f = Archive(zim_path)

def clean_wiki_html(html_text):
    # 去掉<style>...</style>和<script>...</script>块
    text = re.sub(r'<style[^>]*>.*?</style>', '', html_text, flags=re.DOTALL|re.IGNORECASE)
    text = re.sub(r'<script[^>]*>.*?</script>', '', text, flags=re.DOTALL|re.IGNORECASE)
    # 去掉所有HTML标签
    text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', text)
    # 合并空白
    text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text).strip()
    # 去掉一些常见的前缀
    text = re.sub(r'^[^a-zA-Z]*', '', text)
    return text

q = Query()
q.set_query('machine learning')
searcher = Searcher(f)
results = searcher.search(q)
total = results.getEstimatedMatches()
print(f'总匹配数: {total}')

result_set = results.getResults(0, 3)

for i, entry_str in enumerate(result_set):
    print(f'\\n=== 结果 {i+1} ===')
    
    title_for_lookup = entry_str.replace('_', ' ')
    
    try:
        if f.has_entry_by_title(title_for_lookup):
            e = f.get_entry_by_title(title_for_lookup)
            actual_title = e.title
            if e.is_redirect:
                e = e.get_redirect_entry()
                actual_title = e.title
            item = e.get_item()
            html_bytes = bytes(item.content)
            html_text = html_bytes.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
            text = clean_wiki_html(html_text)
            # 取前200个字符作为简短摘要，但跳过标题本身
            snippet = text[:250]
            print(f'📄 标题: {actual_title}')
            print(f'📝 摘要: {snippet}...')
        else:
            print(f'标题: {title_for_lookup} (未找到)')
    except Exception as ex:
        print(f'错误: {ex}')
"
